title: Contract, module stubs, synthetic pipeline, tests
done_when: pip install -e .[dev] and python -m pytest -q pass; run_all.py --synthetic writes outputs/results.json

title: yfinance download with auto_adjust, cache, data checks
done_when: load_prices() returns Prices for UNIVERSE from 2010; cache reloads offline; check_prices() reports gaps and zero/negative prices

title: Split, cumulative, equal-weight basket, gap by year, stats
done_when: overnight+intraday equals daily to 1e-12; summary() gives mean/vol/sharpe per series; tests pass

title: Pipeline on real data, results.json and headline chart
done_when: python scripts/run_all.py writes outputs/results.json and outputs/figures/cumulative_split.png from real data

title: Factor ETF excess-over-SPY split from common start
done_when: excess_split() returns overnight/intraday excess per factor ETF from common_start(); stats in results.json under factors

title: Four strategies: all-day, overnight leg, intraday leg, switching
done_when: run_all() returns 4 StrategyResult with daily gross returns and trades per day; switching trades 2/day; tests pass

title: Cost sweep 0/1/2/5 bp and break-even cost
done_when: cost_sweep() gives Sharpe per strategy per cost; breakeven_bp() solves Sharpe=0 for switching; in results.json

title: P2: 12-1 momentum WML on large-caps, split overnight/intraday
done_when: wml_split() returns SplitReturns for WML; a test proves ranks use only prior month-end data

title: All figures from results and series
done_when: five PNGs in outputs/figures/ with titles, units and source note; test_plots passes

title: 6-slide deck + 2 backup slides and speaker notes
done_when: deck/ has the exported PDF; every number matches results.json at tag v1-numbers

title: Timed rehearsal and send the deck
